summary: Completed Phase-2 backend + frontend regression on public URL for semester programs, assignments/progress, files/object storage + RBAC, events/replays, voice studio provider-ready session, dashboard quick links, mobile overflow, and persistence checks.

critical.issue: Voice session metadata persistence is not externally verifiable: /api/voice/session writes records, but no read endpoint exists and export payload omits voice_sessions.

integration_issues.flow: Voice session metadata persistence across logout/login
integration_issues.issue: UI can start provider-ready sessions and display status, but there is no API/UI retrieval path to confirm previously created voice session metadata after re-login.

action_items: Add a read API for student voice sessions (e.g., GET /api/voice/sessions) and/or include voice_sessions in /api/student/export for persistence verification.
Optionally expose latest voice session history in Voice Studio UI after re-login to satisfy end-user persistence visibility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py currently records voice sessions in db.voice_sessions but has no retrieval endpoint for student-owned session history, reducing observability and testability of required persistence behavior.
student export excludes voice_sessions despite being part of student-generated personal data domain.

success_rate.backend: 88% of requested scope (all requested endpoints passed; one persistence-verification contract gap)

seed_data_creation: Created assignment submission, uploaded file in object storage, event RSVP/attendance, and voice session records during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: /programs shows 13 program cards with 4 tracks each; assignment submit updates progress and persists after re-login; documents upload/list/download/export works; RBAC blocks non-owner file download (403) while admin succeeds (200); events RSVP persists after reload/relogin; replays list count=6 with transcript/languages; voice studio shows 12 professors, mode switch works, session status text_tts_active_until_voice_key_added returned; dashboard quick links all navigate; mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: RCA: Voice-session persistence verification gap is architectural/contract-level, not runtime failure. Repro: create session via POST /api/voice/session (200, DB write confirmed by behavior), logout/login, attempt to verify prior sessions via available APIs. There is no GET endpoint for voice session history, and /api/student/export omits voice_sessions. Mitigation: add GET /api/voice/sessions scoped by user_id and include voice_sessions in export payload for data-governance completeness.
